Hey y’all!

Week two’s blog will be short and sweet…I think. We are officially at one week and a half of construction with this project, and I have the pics to prove it.

Family room and formal living/dining before and demo

Kitchen before and demo

Secondary bath before and demo

There are other changes to come, but this first month of October I’m focusing on the kitchen and hall bath/powder bath, painting and flooring. The primary bathroom will be the last part of this challenge and we just might need all four weeks to get it done.

So what are your thoughts? Let me know in the comments below!

Until next time ORCers,

XOXO,

Brittany
